arxiv-2302-02057.title: Semantic Diffusion Network for Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2302-02057.creator: Haoru Tan Sitong Wu Baidu Research tanhr2014@163.com, wusitong98@gmail.comjpi@connect.ust.hk Jimin Pi
arxiv-2302-02057.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Haoru Tan Sitong Wu Baidu Research tanhr2014@163.com, wusitong98@gmail.comjpi@connect.ust.hk Jimin Pi. Precise and accurate predictions over boundary areas are essential for semantic segmentation. However, the commonly-used convolutional operators tend to smooth and blur local detail cues, making it difficult for deep models to generate accurate boundary predictions. In this paper, we introduce an operator-level approach to enhance semantic boundary awareness, so as to improve the prediction of the deep semantic segmentation model. Specifically, we first formulate the boundary feature enhancement as an anisotropic diffusion process.

arxiv-2403-08071.title: Schubert valuations on Grassmann varieties
arxiv-2403-08071.creator: Rocco Chirivì, Xin Fang, Peter Littelmann
arxiv-2403-08071.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rocco Chirivì, Xin Fang, Peter Littelmann. The goal of the paper is twofold: on one side it provides an order structure on the set of all maximal chains in the Bruhat poset of Schubert varieties in a Grassmann variety; on the other hand, using this order structure, it works out explicit formulae for the valuation and the Newton-Okounkov body associated to each maximal chain appearing in the framework of Seshadri stratification.

arxiv-2409-09218.title: AI as Extraherics: Fostering Higher-order Thinking Skills in Human-AI Interaction
arxiv-2409-09218.creator: Koji Yatani, Zefan Sramek, Chi-Lan Yang
arxiv-2409-09218.description: Abstract . As artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, including generative AI, continue to evolve, concerns have arisen about over-reliance on AI, which may lead to human deskilling and diminished cognitive engagement. Over-reliance on AI can also lead users to accept information given by AI without performing critical examinations, causing negative consequences, such as misleading users with hallucinated contents.

pmc-10674385.creator: Evelina Simkute, Arnoldas Pautienius, Juozas Grigas, Paulina Urbute, Arunas Stankevicius
pmc-10674385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The rising awareness and increasing number of case reports of tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) in dogs indicate that the virus might be an important tick-borne pathogen in dogs, especially in endemic areas. Therefore, the aim of the present study was to investigate the prevalence rate of TBEV RNA and TBEV-specific antibodies in clinical samples of dogs living in a highly endemic region of Lithuania and to evaluate the main risk factors for severe disease course and death.

pmc-11445104.creator: Aliyu Muhammad Koko, Ali Lasseini
pmc-11445104.description: INTRODUCTIONPrimary and metastatic tumours of the skull are relatively rare and have variable histological characteristics. They have been reported to represent 0.8 to 1% of all bone tumours and majority were malignant with attendant morbidity and mortality. With the current advances in neurosurgical techniques, neuroimaging and improvement in histopathological diagnosis more cases are expected to be diagnosed and treated successfully.

pmc-12631289.creator: Teresa Larriba-González, Marina García-Martín, Doddy Denise Ojeda-Hernández, Paula Rincón-Cerrada, Lucía Martín-Blanco, María Soledad Benito-Martín, Belén Selma-Calvo, Sarah de la Fuente-Martín, Jordi A Matias-Guiu, Jorge Matias-Guiu, Ulises Gómez-Pinedo
